column1: Melt the butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Stir in the flour and cook, stirring, about 2 minutes until bubbling but not browned.
Slowly whisk in the milk until smooth.
Bring to a simmer while stirring, then lower the heat and cook 2–3 minutes until it coats the back of a spoon.
Take off the heat and season with salt, pepper, and nutmeg. Adjust salt to taste.
